+  const displayNameInput = document.getElementById('account-display-name');
+  const profileError = document.getElementById('user-profile-error');
+
+  if (profileForm && usernameInput && displayNameInput) {
+    const clearProfileError = inputEl => {
+      inputEl.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
+      if (
+        !usernameInput.hasAttribute('aria-invalid') &&
+        !displayNameInput.hasAttribute('aria-invalid') &&
+        profileError
+      ) {
+        profileError.hidden = true;
+      }
+    };
+
+    usernameInput.addEventListener('input', () => clearProfileError(usernameInput));
+    displayNameInput.addEventListener('input', () => clearProfileError(displayNameInput));
+
+    profileForm.addEventListener('submit', async e => {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      const updatedName = usernameInput.value.trim();
+      const updatedDisplayName = displayNameInput.value.trim();
+
+      if (!updatedName || !updatedDisplayName) {
+        if (!updatedDisplayName) {
+          displayNameInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
+          displayNameInput.focus();
+        }
+        if (!updatedName) {
+          usernameInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
+          if (updatedDisplayName) usernameInput.focus();
+        }
+        if (profileError) profileError.hidden = false;
+        return;
+      }
+
+      const submitBtn = profileForm.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
+      if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;
+      try {
+        await performUserRename(updatedName, updatedDisplayName);
+      } finally {
+        if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
+      }
+    });
+  }
+
+  // Conditional "Create passkey" button feature detection & handler
+  const createButton = document.getElementById('create-passkey');
+  const fallbackNotice = document.getElementById('passkey-unsupported-notice');
+  if (createButton) {
+    isPasskeySupported().then(supported => {
+      if (!supported) {
+        createButton.hidden = true;
+        if (fallbackNotice) fallbackNotice.hidden = false;
+      } else {
+        createButton.hidden = false;
+        if (fallbackNotice) fallbackNotice.hidden = true;
+      }
+    });
+
+    createButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      registerPasskey(false);
+    });
+  }
+
+  // Restore Demo Passkeys button (handy when all passkeys are deleted during testing)
+  const resetDemoBtn = document.getElementById('reset-demo-passkeys');
+  if (resetDemoBtn) {
+    resetDemoBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
+      const response = await resetDemoCredentialsFetch();
+      const { rpId, userId, user, credentials } = await response.json();
+      renderUI(credentials, user);
+      await syncAcceptedCredentials(rpId, userId, credentials);
+      showFeedbackBanner('Demo passkeys restored and synchronized.', 'info');
+    });
+  }
+}
+
+async function initPasskeyManagement() {
+  setupDialogsAndForms();
+  await loadManagementPanel();
+}
+
+if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
+  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initPasskeyManagement);
+} else {
+  initPasskeyManagement();
+}

+  if (!user) {
+    const newUserId = generateBase64UrlRandom(16);
+    user = {
+      id: newUserId,
+      passkeyUserId: newUserId,
+      name,
+      displayName: displayName || name.split('@')[0],
+      favoriteRoast: 'Maple Oat Latte',
+      defaultLocation: 'Downtown Roastery — 412 Bean St',
+      rewardsPoints: mode === 'register' ? 150 : 320,
+    };

+    user.displayName = displayName;

+  if (!encodedCredential || !encodedCredential.id) {
+    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Invalid assertion response.' }, 400);
